title: Jailbreak Complexity Cost Estimator: Measuring Attack Effort vs. Success Rate Tradeoff

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Standardizing cost measurement enables realistic threat modeling. A low-cost moderate-success attack is more dangerous than a high-cost high-success one. Clear chain from measurement to calibrated defense prioritization.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Measuring API calls, prompt length, and generation time is straightforward instrumentation. AISafetyLab implements the attack methods. The measurement harness is a wrapper around existing tools. Beginners can implement this with mentor guidance.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Multiple attack types x multiple models x multiple cost dimensions creates a substantial matrix. Normalizing into a single 'Attack Effort Score' requires judgment. The frontier plot is a clear deliverable but getting there requires many runs. Could fit in 30 hours if limited to 3 attack types x 3 models.
